svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How to read a topographic contour map
svg.desc: A contour map of two hills with brown contour lines every 20 m and thicker labelled index contours every 100 m. Numbered markers show an index contour, the contour interval, closely spaced lines on a steep slope, widely spaced lines on a gentle slope, the summit with its spot height, a saddle between the hills, V-shaped bends pointing upstream along a blue stream, and a closed depression drawn with inward ticks. Below, a side profile along line A to B shows the same hill, gentle on the west and steep on the east.
